name: Spencer Damon
main_effect:
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your yellow Digimon is suspended, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If the total cards in both players' security stacks is 6 or less, until the end of your opponent's turn, treat this Tamer as a 3000 DP Digimon that can't digivolve and gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
